# Align grid.Row and table.Body cell component renderer lifecycle

## Problem

Following #4574 (PR #20352), comparing `Neo.grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` and `Neo.table.Body#applyRendererOutput` exposes symmetric lifecycle gaps in how cell components are hosted:

1. **Functional components in `grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` (and per-instance `vdom` isolation in `functional.component.Base`):**
   - `src/grid/Row.mjs` checks `if (rendererOutput instanceof Neo.component.Base)` (line 225) instead of `AbstractComponent`. A column renderer or `grid.column.Component` returning a functional component (`Neo.functional.component.Base`, which extends `Neo.component.Abstract`) is missed by `me.components[column.dataField]`, never emits `createVdomReference()`, renders an empty cell in the DOM, and never receives `mounted`, `theme`, or `destroy` lifecycle forwarding from the row.
   - `src/functional/component/Base.mjs` defines `vdom: {}` in `static config` without cloning `me.vdom` onto the instance in `construct(config)` (unlike `Neo.component.Base#construct`, which clones `me._vdom`). When multiple instances of a functional component render (such as across multiple rows in a Grid or Table), `continueUpdateWithVdom` mutates the shared `FunctionalBase.prototype.vdom` object in place, causing earlier instances to inherit the last rendered instance's VDOM and ID.
2. **Mounted state & `component` renderer parameter in `table.Body`:**
   - `src/table/Body.mjs` forwards `theme` (`afterSetTheme`) and `windowId` (`afterSetWindowId`) to `this.createdCellComponents`, but lacks `afterSetMounted` forwarding (unlike `grid.Row#afterSetMounted`), so cell components created inside a table body never transition `mounted` when the body mounts or unmounts.
   - `table.Body#applyRendererOutput` does not pass `component: me.createdCellComponents?.get(cellId)` into `column.renderer.call(...)` (unlike `grid.Row#applyRendererOutput`, which passes `component: me.components?.[column.dataField]`), preventing imperative component renderers in tables from inspecting or reusing their existing record-scoped cell component instance across `recordChange` and `store.sort()`.

## Contract Ledger

| Consumed Surface | Owner / Host | Consumer(s) | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `renderer({..., component})` | `Neo.table.Body#applyRendererOutput` (`src/table/Body.mjs`) | `Neo.table.header.Button#renderer` callers | Passes `component: me.createdCellComponents?.get(cellId)` (the existing record-scoped cell component instance, or `undefined` on first render) in the renderer data object, matching `Neo.grid.Row#applyRendererOutput`. |
| `rendererOutput instanceof Neo.component.Abstract` | `Neo.grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` (`src/grid/Row.mjs`) & `Neo.functional.component.Base#construct` (`src/functional/component/Base.mjs`) | `Neo.grid.column.Component` & custom `Neo.grid.column.Base#renderer` implementations returning `Neo.component.Base` or `Neo.functional.component.Base` | Registers any `Neo.component.Abstract` instance in `row.components[column.dataField]`, emits `rendererOutput.createVdomReference()`, relays `mounted` / `theme` / `windowId`, and isolates `me.vdom` per functional component instance so multi-row grids render each row's functional component independently. |
| `afterSetMounted(value, oldValue)` & initial `mounted` config | `Neo.table.Body` (`src/table/Body.mjs`) | Body-owned cell components in `table.Body#createdCellComponents` | Forwards `mounted: me.mounted` at creation time (`ClassSystemUtil.beforeSetInstance`) and relays `component.mounted = value` in `afterSetMounted`, matching `afterSetTheme` and `afterSetWindowId`. |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.grid.Row#applyRendererOutput` checks `rendererOutput instanceof AbstractComponent` (and `Neo.functional.component.Base#construct` clones `me.vdom` per instance) so both classic (`Neo.component.Base`) and functional (`Neo.functional.component.Base`) cell components are registered in `me.components[column.dataField]`, emit `createVdomReference()`, and render independently per row in a browser e2e test (`test/playwright/e2e/grid/FunctionalComponentCell.spec.mjs`).
- [ ] `Neo.table.Body` implements `afterSetMounted(value, oldValue)` forwarding `mounted` to `this.createdCellComponents` (and passes `mounted: me.mounted` and `parentComponent: me` on creation).
- [ ] `Neo.table.Body#applyRendererOutput` keeps `createdCellComponents` keyed by the record-scoped `cellId`, passes `component: me.createdCellComponents?.get(cellId)` into `column.renderer.call(...)`, and reuses per-record instances across `recordChange` and `store.sort()` without cross-record state leakage when a renderer omits config keys on some records.
- [ ] Unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/table/BodyRendererInstances.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/column/Component.spec.mjs` and browser e2e test in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/FunctionalComponentCell.spec.mjs` verify all behaviors.
